concerns.text: The plan computes gene‑wise variance **across all samples** (including the held‑out dataset) and selects the top K most variable genes before the Leave‑One‑Dataset‑Out (LODO) cross‑dataset evaluation (see lines: “Compute variance across all samples, select top K most variable genes (K = 50, 100, 150).” and “perform Leave‑One‑Dataset‑Out (LODO) … using the top K most variable genes”). This leaks information from the test fold into the predictor construction, violating the independence requirement for validation and rendering the reported cross‑dataset accuracy circularly optimistic.

UMAP embeddings and silhouette‑score calculations are performed on the held‑out test samples using the same top K genes selected from the full dataset (including the test set). Because the feature set was chosen with knowledge of the test data, the unsupervised validation is not independent of the predictor, further compromising the claimed evidence of intrinsic stress clustering.
